core_principle: The local LLM forms hypotheses. Splunk establishes facts. Deterministic controls enforce policy. The analyst owns the decision.
dataset_agnostic_rules: Do not hardcode indexes, sourcetypes, sources or data models
Do not hardcode fields, event IDs, vendors or use-case mappings
Do not hardcode users, hosts, IPs, domains, entities, thresholds or IOCs
Use only analyst-supplied values, live Splunk-discovered values or validated observed values
Reject unsupported field mappings and abstain when evidence is insufficient

spl_read_only_policy.description: Generic read-only SPL safety policy enforced by the live SPL validator. This policy is product safety configuration, not customer dataset logic.

v1_caveats: No high-availability deployment pattern in V1
evidence_requirements: Qualify sources using live profiles rather than source-name resemblance
Validate fields and observed values before compiling SPL
Require bounded co-occurrence evidence for multi-concept claims
Link model claims to evidence ledger IDs
Calculate confidence and risk deterministically from evidence
